facts.fact: The president of Cabo Verde's CNPD, Faustino Varela Monteiro, signed an agreement joining Morocco's DATA-TIKA compliance programme, showing the commission in operation.

systems.country_label: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados

facts.fact: The president of Morocco's CNDP, Omar Seghrouchni, signed an agreement admitting Cabo Verde's CNPD to the CNDP's DATA-TIKA programme, set up on 9 July 2020.

systems.country_label: Commission nationale de contrôle de la protection des données à caractère personnel

CPV.note: Refers only to legislation in force in general; no law named.

MAR.note: Refers only to legislation in force in general; no law named.

CPV.note: Nothing on rules for sending data abroad.

facts.fact: Morocco's CNDP signed an agreement with Cabo Verde's data protection commission, CNPD, committing both to cooperate on personal data protection, with CNDP to train CNPD staff.
